description.title: Dominik Pokorný
description.heading: My name is Dominik Pokorný
paragraphs: I am a personal masseur for men, a cook, and an athlete.

I know well what it's like to work hard for weeks, deal with life's worries, and have fatigue and stress pile up. That's why I started massaging and creating a safe space where people can pause and truly live. I help return lightness to the body, joy of movement, and above all, peace of mind.
Because everyone deserves to finally release accumulated stress and inner tension and experience true relaxation.
points: I focus on quality, not quantity — a maximum of two clients per day.
I come directly to your home, no travel or parking hassle.
Care is always tailored to your needs, boundaries, and current condition.
description.text: My name is Dominik Pokorný. I am a personal masseur for men and I help people restore lightness, movement and calm to their bodies.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.heading: Finnish massage and care tailored to your needs
pricing.subtitle: Traditional Finnish massage at the intensity you prefer — gentle and relaxing or very deep.

services.title: Finnish massage
paragraphs: Traditional Finnish massage at the intensity you prefer.
It can be very gentle and relaxing, or very intense - everything depends on what you want.

services.title: Trigger point release
paragraphs: Every massage includes palpation of the treated areas to find any tight muscles suitable for pressure therapy.
Releasing these points is briefly intense but brings significant long-term relief from pain and restores mobility.
This work is always performed only after agreement with you and according to your wishes.

services.title: Cupping
paragraphs: Cupping is an effective way to release chronically tight muscles that regular massage cannot reach. Glass cups are applied to the skin to create suction and encourage release.

short.title: Quick massage
short.advantage: The best short time slot to restore energy with the help of cupping. A great option for people looking for a quick relaxation and refresh during a busy week.

basic.title: Shortened massage
basic.advantage: A great opportunity to quickly relieve sore, stiff back and neck in the middle of a busy week.

pro.title: Standard massage
pro.advantage: Deep muscle release for the areas that trouble you most from sitting at a computer, plus a mental unwind from work worries and deep relaxation.

deluxe.title: Full-body Premium massage
deluxe.advantage:
An ideal gift if you want to reward someone, give them a genuine experience, and introduce them to a healthy lifestyle that doesn't end with this massage. It will help them embark on a new, healthier chapter in life.

A thorough deep full-body massage tailored to your preferences — an experience you won't forget.

In addition to an excellent massage, this package includes various bonuses, for example:

  • Practical extras that make a healthy lifestyle accessible exactly where you are in life and with what you are currently doing.
  • A special heated table during the entire procedure to provide pleasant warmth where you are not being massaged.
  • Cooling and warming compresses — heat for deep release, cold targeted where calming an acute irritation is needed.
  • Premium refreshments that taste great and help the body replenish important nutrients and minerals used during the massage.
Notice: The Premium massage must be booked at least one week in advance, or arranged by phone at 731 345 567.

pricing.eligibilityInfo:
Massage cannot be performed if I notice any of the following or if you have been diagnosed with:

  1. Acute injuries
  2. Malignant tumors – could spread malignant cells to other parts and organs
  3. Suppurative skin diseases – risk of spreading infection to other parts of the customer's and masseur's skin.
  4. Certain skin rashes – e.g., erysipelas, chickenpox, measles.
  5. Tuberculosis of bones, joints, tendons and active pulmonary TB – risk of spreading Koch's bacillus to other parts.
  6. Certain types of constipation – could damage the inner wall of the intestine with hard feces.
    • Relates to abdominal massage.
  7. Any inflammation – always requires consultation with a personal physician.
    • Including seemingly unrelated inflammations (e.g., inflammation in the back prevents massage of the lower limbs - risk of spreading the inflammation.)
    • All acute inflammation of the abdominal cavity – risk of peritonitis and possible perforation of the inflamed organ (warm and red spot)
    • Gallstones, gallbladder inflammation, gastric and duodenal ulcers. (In these diseases, abdominal massage is prohibited)
    • Acute joint inflammation. (Symptoms: red skin, joint is painful, warm, movement is limited. The joint area is very sensitive, swollen, enlarged)
    • Note: In chronic joint inflammation, the joint is also swollen, but not red and warm – here massage is actually recommended.
  8. Fever – like any inflammation.
  9. Bleeding disorders – could result in blood extravasation into skin, subcutaneous tissue, muscles, and internal organs.
  10. Varicose veins in the area to be massaged.
  11. General weakness and fatigue of the body.
  12. Cardiac decompensation
    • State where the heart cannot meet the body's needs (such a person is short of breath, has bluish lips, lower limb edema).
  13. Mental illness - e.g., chronic schizophrenia etc.

I hereby declare that I do not suffer from any of the above contraindications that would make massage impossible, my statement is truthful, and I take responsibility for concealing any health complications the masseur should know about.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything important before booking in one place.

items.question: Do I need to prepare for the massage?
answer: Only three things are needed: fill out the questionnaire truthfully before booking, avoid heavy meals at least an hour before the massage, and plan a more restful day afterwards.
No other special preparation is required from you — I will take care of everything else.

items.question: Do I have to be naked during the massage?
answer: I respect clients' boundaries and maintain maximum discretion regarding intimacy and private areas.
The usual standard is underwear, which is adjusted under a clean sheet — whatever is not being massaged is discreetly covered.

items.question: Do you massage women?
items.answer: For personal reasons, my clientele is set exclusively to men.

items.question: Does it matter if I'm gay?
items.answer: Your sexual orientation is not an obstacle for the massage.

items.question: Do you massage intimate areas?
items.answer: No, this is not part of any full-body massage. I do not provide erotic services.

items.question: Does it hurt?
answer: It depends on our agreement and your expectations.
If you want a gentle relaxing massage, it won't hurt. If you want deeper work or trigger point release, it can be more intense, but it helps the body in the long term.

items.question: How does it work?
answer: I come to your home (or your environment), bring everything needed, and create a zone of calm right where you normally are.
The equipment includes a heated mat, oil warmer, scented candles, and relaxing tea.
After a brief discussion, the massage takes place, then I pack everything up and you can continue to relax. The next day I recommend a lighter schedule without strenuous physical activity.

items.question: Why should I book your services?
items.answer: Because I focus on quality, not quantity. My limit is two clients per day so I can give each one maximum care — and everything happens at your home without unnecessary travel.

items.quote: The massage was really deep and intense, but also very professional. Right after, I felt my body was straighter, lighter, and full of energy. And even better — after a few days, a pleasant relaxation set in that lasted. I definitely recommend it.
items.name: Richard K.

items.quote: Dominik has a very professional and personal approach. I had extremely stiff muscles around my spine due to work and almost daily gym. After a thorough and careful massage, there was huge relief. He was precise and hit exactly the spots that needed to be released. Maximum satisfaction.
items.name: Aleš P.

items.quote: Dominik approaches a relaxing massage in a very holistic way. The massage duration doesn’t count just from entering the apartment to leaving - he first creates a pleasant atmosphere with tea, candles, and a friendly conversation. During the massage he continuously checks your comfort and the relaxing treatment isn’t interrupted by small talk about the weather or politics. I truly had the chance to disconnect from work and everyday stress and simply be present for a moment. Thank you! 🙏
